brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir taunted Palestinian detainee Hassan Salama in his cell in footage that sparked sharp condemnation from Palestinians, Al Jazeera English reported. The incident, which was captured on video, showed the minister making threats against Salama during what appeared to be a detention facility visit.

Palestinian officials and civil society groups condemned Ben-Gvir's conduct as abusive and a violation of detainee rights. The episode intensified tensions over the treatment of Palestinians held in Israeli custody.
dek: Footage of national security minister taunting Hassan Salama in his cell draws sharp condemnation from Palestinians.
title: Ben-Gvir taunts detained Palestinian, draws Palestinian condemnation
